### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the change restoring zero-start indicator imports. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes the initial CrowdStrike indicator request when `indicator_start_timestamp=0`, restoring the documented “import all indicators” behavior. This addresses part of #8545; state recovery and API error propagation remain out of scope. **Changes:** - Omits the initial `_marker` clause for a zero cursor while preserving type exclusions and subsequent pagination filters. - Omits the API `filter` parameter when no filter is needed. - Adds regression coverage for zero-start pagination and client parameter handling. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​crowdstrike/​tests/​test_indicator_pagination.py` | Tests zero-start filters, cursor advancement, and API filter omission. | | `external-import/​crowdstrike/​src/​crowdstrike_feeds_services/​client/​indicators.py` | Accepts an optional filter and omits it from requests when absent. | | `external-import/​crowdstrike/​src/​crowdstrike_feeds_connector/​indicator/​importer.py` | Skips the marker clause for a zero cursor, retaining type exclusions. |
Review effort: Balanced
